nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the protagonist defined by the character sheet in <Picture 1>. The sheet provides her identity and wardrobe consistently throughout the video.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a 10-second cinematic emotional scene featuring <Subject 1> facing a man at night. She initially holds back tears, lowers her gaze, then gently wipes beneath her right eye. Her expression gradually softens into a tearful smile. After a cut to a wider composition, she looks down, smiles at him again, and finally turns partly away.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - follow the identity and wardrobe in <Picture 1> across both shots, allowing natural changes in expression, posture, and viewing angle. Use the character sheet as a subject reference, not as a starting frame or scene composition.

detailed_description:
A photorealistic cinematic drama, 10 seconds, 16:9. A quiet nighttime setting with a dark, softly blurred background, subdued green tones, and warm highlights. Soft directional lighting makes subtle expressions and tears readable. Use shallow depth of field and restrained, naturalistic acting.

[Shot 1] Begin with a steady over-the-shoulder close-up of <Subject 1>, positioned slightly left of center. The man stands opposite her, his blurred head and shoulder framing the right foreground. She looks directly toward him with tearful eyes and slightly parted lips, holding back emotion without exaggerated sobbing.

During the first two seconds, she slowly lowers her gaze and chin. Her lips press together briefly as she pauses, then she raises her eyes toward him again. Her expression begins to soften while the tears remain visible.

Around three seconds, she lifts her right hand and lightly places her fingertips beneath her right eye. She gently wipes outward along the upper cheek in one small, continuous motion, briefly narrowing the eye during contact. She lowers her hand fully out of frame, glances down, then looks back at the man. A tentative smile develops into a warmer, tearful smile. Keep the camera nearly stationary and maintain focus on her expression.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, hard cut to a slightly wider over-the-shoulder medium close-up, framing <Subject 1> from the chest upward. Preserve the same screen positions and eyeline, with the man's shoulder remaining blurred on screen right.

She presses her lips together and briefly lowers her chin, containing a small smile. After a short pause, she lifts her gaze toward him. Her smile brightens, and her lips part and move briefly as if giving a quiet response, without prescribing specific words. Keep the performance gentle and intimate rather than turning the smile into laughter.

During the final second, she lowers her eyes, lets the smile soften, and begins turning her head and shoulders toward screen left. End at 10 seconds with her still visible, turned partly away from the man. Do not complete an exit. Preserve the emotional progression from restrained hurt, through wiping away a tear, to a relieved smile and a quiet turn away.
